title: Highly recommended
text:
Super recommended, I loved it 
Worth every minute
author: katyaisabell

title: Absolutely mesmerising
text:
Absolutely brilliant. One hour show which was just right for us. Every seat has a great view of the stage.

Dancers were absolutely brilliant. Mesmerising. Really enjoyed the show and the passion by the performers 

Excellent and good value for money
author: Ripley25

title: Well worth the experience
text: You’re allowed to photograph the first five minutes – no flash. From a seeking comfort perspective, there was a barrier at the front of the step down to the next level which you could not put your feet through.
author: W8087NQpeterg

title: Captivating performance
text: One hour in a dimly lit atmospheric smallish theatre being royally entertained by 2 singers, 1 guitarist and 3 dancers. Absolutely captivating. Just brilliant
author: Brett99

title: Great flamenco show
text:
Perfect flamenco experience for first timers. 
Very professional, high quality show and the pace was just right.
The passion and the drama was evident and it’s recommended!
author: N9999AAalanb

title: Flamengo Theater Seville
text: It was beautiful and very intense! A very beautiful show that I am very grateful for!!!
author: Adventure06706922576

title: Sensational flamenco show
text: I was determined to watch a flamenco show in Seville, and this was exactly what I expected. Wonderful. Sensational musicians, singers, and dancers. For those who want to see authentic flamenco in Spain, I recommend.
author: cristhianev2014

title: Seville!
text: What a great way to get an overview of the city. Our driver Roberto, did an amazing job. He is knowledgeable and very entertaining! We recommend it highly.
author: maggiemU8482DI

title: Good tour
text: Started a little too quickly—both pace and speaking; but slowed down and was then a fantastic guide!  Very interesting architecture and history at the mosque/cathedral. The Jewish quarter was also interesting but far less so.
author: Renee_Y
